specDef.name: sheetco
specDef.title: SheetCo
specDef.product: SheetCo builds a small spreadsheet engine. The team designs its own module split and interfaces in the kickoff meeting; requirements arrive in waves.
specDef.context: The product: Sheet, a spreadsheet engine, specified by behaviour only in live/bench5r/SPEC5.md (read all of it; it grows by waves, and every new wave is announced on the company channel and in your brief). There is no module spec: the kickoff meeting MTG-1 decides the split into four module slots (A-D) plus the integration module (SHEET), every interface between them, and which slot owns which behaviour; ARCH.md (order ARCH, in live/bench5r/work/ARCH/) records those decisions and is the contract. Each slot's module lives in live/bench5r/work/MOD-<slot>/<file named in ARCH.md>; modules import each other by relative paths ARCH.md gives. Shipped modules are in live/bench5r/shipped/. Hidden acceptance tests run only on the integrated sheet and report failing categories; every shipped order is tested again after each later ship. When a wave's failure is in another slot's module, say so in your report: the slot's owner fixes it. The org is in ORG.md.

MOD-B: the module in slot B
MOD-C: the module in slot C
MOD-D: the module in slot D

agenda.title: The module split: what behaviour each of slots A-D owns, now (wave 1) and as later waves add references, functions, recalculation and cycles; which slot each builder owns

dev-2.text: Split by pipeline stage so each later wave lands mostly in ONE slot. A = PARSER (formula text -> AST): tokenizer, precedence (cmp < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc, unary binds to the next atom so -2^2=4), number syntax (1.2.3 bad), strings, TRUE/FALSE, call syntax NAME(args) parsed now even though wave 1 has no functions (so #NAME? is an eval decision, not a parse failure), and from wave 2 cell refs/ranges plus refs(ast) listing referenced cells. B = VALUES: the value/error representation, cell-name validation/normalisation (A1..Z99, case-insensitive, no leading zero), literal parsing for set() (" -2.5 ", .5, 12abc stays text), coercions (toNumber with ""->0, bool->1/0, numeric text; toText; case-insensitive compare), round9 and display(). C = EVALUATOR: walks the AST over B values, operator semantics, error propagation (left error wins), non-finite -> #VALUE!, #DIV/0!, and the function table (wave 1: every call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions are added here only). D = STORE + DEPENDENCY GRAPH: raw text/AST/value per cell, wave 1 just storage; wave 2-3 dependents, recalc order (topological), cycle detection. SHEET = thin glue: createSheet() wires B (names, literals, display), A, C, D. Ownership (balances wave-1 load and keeps related reasoning together): dev-1 owns A and D (structural: syntax and graph), dev-2 owns B and C (semantics: values and evaluation). SHEET owned by lead (or whoever ARCH names) since it only composes. Rationale: hidden tests fail by category; with this split a failing category maps to one owner.

reviewer.text: Split by pipeline stage so each later wave lands in one or two slots, not all four. A = formula syntax (work/MOD-A/parse.mjs): tokenizer + precedence parser (comparison < & < +- < */ < ^ right-assoc; unary binds to the atom so -2^2=4; 1.2.3 and unbalanced parens = parse error), cell-name validation/canonicalisation (A1..Z99, case-insensitive, no leading zero); wave 2 adds ref/range/call nodes here only. B = value model (work/MOD-B/values.mjs): error values, literal-input parsing (" -2.5 ", .5, 7 -> number; "12abc","TRUE" -> text), coercion (""->0, bool->1/0, numeric text->number, else #VALUE!), every operator incl. case-insensitive string compare and & text forms, non-finite -> #VALUE!, round-to-9, display(). C = evaluator (work/MOD-C/eval.mjs): walks the AST, left operand first so left error wins, unknown call -> #NAME?; wave 2 functions live in C (functions.mjs beside it), refs resolved through a callback so C never sees storage. D = cell store + dependency graph (work/MOD-D/store.mjs): inputs, cached values, wave 2/3 dependents, recalculation order, cycle detection. In wave 1 D is thin: that is deliberate headroom, it absorbs waves 2-3. SHEET = wiring only (createSheet, throw on bad names). Builders: dev-1 owns A + C (they share the AST contract, one person avoids drift); dev-2 owns B + D. Lead owns SHEET. Reviewer checks each slot against SPEC5 examples and the ARCH contract, and names the owning slot on any failing category.

dev-1.text: Split along the pipeline so each slot grows in exactly one wave and nobody edits another slot to add a feature. A = syntax (MOD-A/parse.mjs): tokenizer + precedence-climbing parser -> AST, cell-name validation/normalisation; from wave 1 it already parses calls NAME(args) (so =FOO(1) gives a call node -> #NAME?, not a syntax error), and wave 2 adds ref/range nodes here only, plus refs(ast) listing referenced cells. B = values (MOD-B/values.mjs): value representation, error values, coercion (toNumber/toText/compare), the operators as pure functions, literal-input parsing for set (" -2.5 " -> -2.5, "12abc" stays text), round9 and display. C = evaluation (MOD-C/eval.mjs): walks the AST using B, resolves refs/ranges through a context callback, owns the function registry (wave 2 functions are added here; wave 1 registry empty -> #NAME?). D = dependencies (MOD-D/graph.mjs): dependency graph, recalc order after a set, cycle detection (wave 3); in wave 1 it is trivial but its interface is fixed now so SHEET does not change shape later. SHEET (SHEET/sheet.mjs): createSheet, cell store {text, ast, value}, wires A->C->D, throws on bad names. Owners: dev-1 takes A and C (parser and evaluator share the AST contract, fewest cross-owner handoffs); dev-2 takes B and D; SHEET goes to whoever finishes first, default dev-2 since it mostly drives D. Wave-1 critical path is A+B+C; D can be a stub that returns [cell] as the recalc order.

lead.text: A=parse.mjs: cell names + formula text -> AST (wave2+: refs, ranges, function calls). B=values.mjs: value/error representation, literal input parsing, coercion, operators, display formatting. C=eval.mjs: AST -> value via a getCell callback; function library (wave2). D=graph.mjs: cell store + dependency graph, recalc order, cycle detection (wave2/3). SHEET wires them. Owners: dev-1 ARCH,A,C; dev-2 B,D,SHEET.

agenda.title: The interfaces: every exported function with its arguments and results, how values and errors are represented, how modules import each other (relative paths), and who writes ARCH.md

dev-2.text: Values (owned by B, used everywhere): number = JS number (finite), text = JS string, boolean = JS boolean, empty = "" , error = frozen object {error:"#DIV/0!"|"#VALUE!"|"#NAME?"|later "#REF!"/"#CIRC!"...}; B exports ERR constants so errors compare by identity or by .error. Files and exports: work/MOD-B/values.mjs: normCell(name)->"A1" uppercase or null; parseLiteral(text)->number|string ("" stays ""); isError(v); makeError(code); toNumber(v)->number|error; toText(v)->string; compareValues(a,b)->-1|0|1 (case-insensitive strings, else numbers; caller handles errors); round9(n); display(v)->string. work/MOD-A/parse.mjs: parse(src) where src is the text AFTER "=", returns AST or {type:"error",code:"#VALUE!"} on bad syntax (never throws). AST nodes: {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op:"-"|"+",arg} {type:"binary",op:"+"|"-"|"*"|"/"|"^"|"&"|"="|"<>"|"<"|">"|"<="|">=",left,right} {type:"call",name (uppercased),args:[]}; reserved for wave 2: {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to}; refs(ast)->string[] of normalised cells (wave 1 returns []). work/MOD-C/eval.mjs: evaluate(ast, ctx)->value where ctx={get(cell)->value} (unused in wave 1); final numbers rounded via round9; imports ../MOD-B/values.mjs. work/MOD-D/store.mjs: createStore()->{setCell(cell,{raw,ast,value}), getCell(cell)->record|undefined, clear(cell), setDeps(cell,cells[]), dependents(cell)->cells in recalc order, cycles()->Set} (graph methods are no-ops/empty in wave 1 but the signatures are fixed now). Imports are relative between sibling module dirs: "../MOD-B/values.mjs" etc., and SHEET imports "../MOD-A/parse.mjs","../MOD-B/values.mjs","../MOD-C/eval.mjs","../MOD-D/store.mjs" - this must hold identically in shipped/ (same dir layout), please confirm. set()/get() throw Error on bad names via normCell. ARCH.md: the lead (chair) writes it right after the meeting from the minutes; builders propose additions by order, the reviewer checks code against it. Changes to an interface need an ARCH amendment before code.

reviewer.text: Values: number | string | boolean | SheetError. B exports class SheetError {code} with frozen singletons ERR.DIV0 ("#DIV/0!"), ERR.VALUE ("#VALUE!"), ERR.NAME ("#NAME?"), reserved ERR.REF/ERR.CYCLE for later waves, and isError(v). Errors are objects, NOT strings, so text "#DIV/0!" typed by a user stays distinguishable; toString() returns the code. (ARCH must state what get() returns for errors; I recommend the SheetError object, display() gives the code.) Empty cell = "". A exports parse(src) -> AST, never throws: nodes {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} {type:"call",name(uppercased),args} {type:"error",code} for bad syntax; reserved for wave 2 {type:"ref",cell} {type:"range",from,to}; plus normCell(name) -> "A1" or null, and refsOf(ast) -> cell names (for D). B exports parseInput(text) -> ""|number|string, toNumber(v), toText(v), unary(op,v), binary(op,a,b) (all -> value incl. errors, never throw), round9(n), display(v) -> string. C exports evaluate(ast, ctx) -> value, ctx = {get(cell)->value, range(from,to)->value[][]} (wave 1 ctx unused). D exports createStore({parse, evaluate}) -> {setInput(cell,text), input(cell), value(cell)} handling recalculation internally. SHEET: createSheet() validates via normCell (throw Error), routes "=" text to parse/store, else parseInput. Imports: relative only, ../MOD-A/parse.mjs, ../MOD-B/values.mjs, ../MOD-C/eval.mjs, ../MOD-D/store.mjs from SHEET and between modules; shipped/ must keep the same MOD-<slot>/ layout or these paths break — ARCH must say so. Dependency direction A,B <- C <- D <- SHEET, no cycles. ARCH.md written by lead as chair right after the meeting; reviewer checks it against SPEC5 before any build starts; changes to an interface only via ARCH edit, never in module code.

dev-1.text: Values: number (finite JS number), string, boolean, "" for empty, and errors as frozen singleton objects from B: ERR.DIV0/ERR.VALUE/ERR.NAME (later ERR.REF, ERR.CYCLE), shape {error:"#DIV/0!"}; isError(v) is the only test, display(v) returns v.error. Modules never throw for sheet-level errors; only SHEET throws (bad cell name). B values.mjs exports: ERR, isError(v), parseInput(text)->number|string|"", toNumber(v)->number|error ("" ->0, bool->1/0, numeric text, else ERR.VALUE), toText(v)->string|error, binary(op,a,b)->value (op in + - * / ^ & = <> < > <= >=; left error wins; non-finite -> ERR.VALUE; /0 -> ERR.DIV0), unary(op,v), round9(n), display(v)->string. A parse.mjs exports: parse(src /*text after =*/)->AST, never throws; bad syntax returns {type:"error",code:"#VALUE!"}. Nodes: {type:"num",value} {type:"str",value} {type:"bool",value} {type:"unary",op,arg} {type:"binary",op,left,right} {type:"call",name /*uppercase*/,args:[AST]}; wave 2 adds {type:"ref",cell:"A1"} {type:"range",from,to}. Also normCell(name)->"A1"|null and refs(ast)->string[]. C eval.mjs exports: evaluate(ast, ctx)->value, ctx={ get(cell)->value, range(from,to)->value[][] }; functions: registerFunction(name, fn(args, ctx)) or a FUNCTIONS map, unknown name -> ERR.NAME. D graph.mjs exports createGraph()->{ setDeps(cell, cells[]), recalcOrder(cell)->string[] (cell then dependents, topological), cyclic()->Set<string> }. SHEET stores round9(evaluate(...)) so refs see the same value get returns. Imports by relative path only: C imports "../MOD-B/values.mjs"; SHEET imports "../MOD-A/parse.mjs", "../MOD-B/values.mjs", "../MOD-C/eval.mjs", "../MOD-D/graph.mjs"; A and D import nothing (A imports B only if needed for ERR codes). Lead writes ARCH.md from the decided positions; each slot owner reviews the section for their slot before builds start; changes to an interface go through the lead and ARCH.md, never by editing another slot.

lead.text: Values: JS number | string | boolean; "" empty; errors are frozen objects {error:"#DIV/0!"} made by B.err(code), tested by B.isError(v). Imports by relative path ../MOD-X/<file>.mjs. dev-1 writes ARCH.md from these minutes.

__map.title: ARCH: the design as decided
__map.accept: live/bench5r/work/ARCH/ARCH.md: the kickoff's decisions (MTG-1 minutes) as the contract. For each slot A-D a section '## Slot X: <file>.mjs' with a line 'exports: <name>, <name>' then the signature and behaviour of each export, what the slot owns across the waves, and its owner; a section on SHEET (live/bench5r/work/SHEET/sheet.mjs, createSheet) saying how it uses the slots; the import paths (../MOD-X/<file>.mjs). Plus one arch.test.mjs that checks ARCH.md has all four slots.
